method: read-only code audit of production modules + card evidence; no runtime modification. Every entry lists the authoritative module path so TA-2 can bind enforcement to the same seam.

capabilities.name: Deterministic DAG graph scheduler
capabilities.purpose: Run a decomposed task as a DAG of nodes (readonly-analyst / writer / repairer / reviewer / verifier / join) with dependency readiness, single-writer lease, bounded repair per node, and a final PASS/HOLD verdict.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Every card execution entry (runColimaGraph / runSubagentGraph / runDurableGraph).
capabilities.currentCaller: Card closeout scripts (scripts/*-self-closeout.mjs), lifecycle-runner, operator pipeline.
capabilities.permissions: Creates fresh executor+reviewer adapters per node; enforces writer lease; schedules ready set from durable truth on resume.
capabilities.sideEffects: Node results map (in-memory unless durable layer engaged); worktree lifecycle; evidence files; closeout trigger.
capabilities.cost: O(nodes × adapters); each node = one Pi process (executor) + optional review process.
capabilities.failureMode: Node HOLD propagates to graph HOLD; writer lease violation -> WRITER_LEASE_VIOLATION; crash loses in-memory state unless durable layer engaged.
capabilities.isolationRequirements: Writer nodes need worktree/Colima isolation; read-only nodes can run host-side or isolated.
capabilities.evidenceRequirements: graph-closeout evidence (nodes, scheduler verdict, review results); node structured results.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: A single direct execution with no decomposition (fast path) does not need a multi-node graph.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Any task decomposed into >1 dependent phases, or requiring independent review, or requiring durable graph semantics.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides: number of nodes, which node roles, whether graph execution is engaged at all (fast path may bypass the graph scheduler entirely).

capabilities.name: Read-only sub-agent (readonly-analyst)
capabilities.purpose: Bound read-only exploration/analysis of the codebase with a frozen minimal context and structured result; used for research, discovery, and pre-decomposition exploration.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Graph node with taskType readonly-analyst; C2D read-only discovery run (operator-tick with AURA_AUTOLOOP_C3A_C2D_READ_ONLY=1).
capabilities.currentCaller: Graph scheduler; C2D read-only-discovery-run; research cards.
capabilities.permissions: TOOL_PERMISSIONS.READ_ONLY = fs.read / fs.grep / fs.list / fs.stat only. No write, no network, no shell.
capabilities.sideEffects: Structured result + evidence; never mutates the repo.
capabilities.cost: One Pi process per node; token cost bounded by context budget.
capabilities.failureMode: Contract violation (missing fields, identity mismatch) -> node cannot PASS (fail-closed).
capabilities.isolationRequirements: None by default; can be run in Colima when host trust is lower.
capabilities.evidenceRequirements: Structured result + test results when verification is part of the node.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Direct execution where the executor itself can answer (XS/LOW fast path).
capabilities.whenMandatory: Research-first tasks; exploration before decomposition; any task whose classification evidence is insufficient.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides whether read-only exploration is required BEFORE execution (research gate) and how many parallel read-only workers are allowed.

capabilities.name: Writer sub-agent (isolated worktree writer)
capabilities.purpose: Apply code changes inside a DEDICATED git worktree (rw at /work) with the source repo read-only at /src; returns structured writer result; executor fail-closes on every contract violation (out-of-scope writes, undeclared files, empty diff, identity mismatch).
capabilities.currentTrigger: Graph node with taskType writer (write_*).
capabilities.currentCaller: Graph scheduler via writer adapter; CBM write-back dogfooding.
capabilities.permissions: Write only inside the dedicated worktree path; mutationScope enforcement; single-writer lease; SCRATCH_WRITE for its own scratch.
capabilities.sideEffects: Worktree diff (captured, reviewable, revocable); never mutates main checkout until an explicit commit step (not in this capability).
capabilities.cost: High: worktree prep + Colima container + Pi writer process + capture/revoke.
capabilities.failureMode: Any contract violation -> node HOLD/REPAIR; worktree revoked on failure; no partial write ever reaches the main tree.
capabilities.isolationRequirements: Mandatory: dedicated worktree + Colima container (mount allowlist ro /src, rw /work).
capabilities.evidenceRequirements: captureWorktreeOutput (changed files + diff), writer structured result, worktree verify.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: XS/LOW tasks executed directly with no mutation-scope separation (fast path); read-only tasks.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Any task that mutates code and requires isolation, independent review, or scope enforcement.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides whether writer capability is granted at all (read-only admission denies it), whether worktree isolation is required, and the mutationScope (authorized paths).

capabilities.name: Independent reviewer (isolated review agent)
capabilities.purpose: A REAL review agent process in an isolated Colima container independently re-examines a writer's output: actual changed files (read-only /work), source (read-only /src), results (read-only /results). Emits structured review result with blockingFindings; never trusts the writer's self-declared status.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Writer sub-agent phases (and strict-review routing for HIGH/CRITICAL risk); review nodes.
capabilities.currentCaller: Graph scheduler at node review stage.
capabilities.permissions: Read-only mounts; private scratch rw only for its own review result; network none.
capabilities.sideEffects: review.json persisted per node; recommendedAction PASS/REPAIR/HOLD drives lifecycle.
capabilities.cost: One extra Pi process + Colima container per reviewed node (significant).
capabilities.failureMode: Malformed/identity-mismatched review -> HOLD (no blind repair); HOLD propagates.
capabilities.isolationRequirements: Isolated container; read-only mounts; no network.
capabilities.evidenceRequirements: review result identity, evidenceChecked, scopeVerified, testsVerified.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: XS/LOW tasks on the fast path; tasks with deterministic verification only.
capabilities.whenMandatory: HIGH/CRITICAL risk (isStrictReviewRisk), writer phases that mutate governed code, external-review-bound tasks, one-card-one-review-surface chains.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides review strength: none / deterministic-verify / independent-review / external-review.

capabilities.name: Bounded repair loop
capabilities.purpose: On REPAIR verdict, re-run the phase with the exact blocking findings, bounded by effective_repair_cap = min(bounded_repair.max_rounds, review_unit.maximum_repair_rounds); budget persists across restarts; exhaustion -> HOLD.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Reviewer/verifier REPAIR recommendation; bounded repair loop in lifecycle.
capabilities.permissions: Re-invokes executor with lastReviewResult; increments attempt counter; cannot exceed cap.
capabilities.sideEffects: Attempt journaling; repair generation artifacts; budget decrement (persisted).
capabilities.cost: Each repair attempt = another executor pass (Pi cost).
capabilities.failureMode: Repair budget exhausted -> HOLD / REPAIR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; never infinite loop.
capabilities.isolationRequirements: Same isolation as the underlying phase (writer repair stays in worktree).
capabilities.evidenceRequirements: attempt count, repair budget, before/after diff, blocking findings binding.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Fast path XS/LOW with zero-failure expectation and no review.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Any reviewed node (a REPAIR must be actionable, never silently re-PASSed).
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission sets the repair budget per task (fast path 0, standard 1, high-risk up to effective cap).

capabilities.name: Colima container isolation
capabilities.purpose: Pinned-instance container runtime: explicit socket (never implicit docker context), mount allowlist (read-only source + scratch rw only), network none, --cap-drop ALL, --security-opt no-new-privileges, pids/memory/cpu limits, no runtime socket in task containers, timeout/cancel/crash cleanup idempotent.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Writer and reviewer sub-agent phases; colima graph runs.
capabilities.permissions: Full isolation boundary for untrusted agent processes.
capabilities.cost: High (VM instance + container startup, CPU/mem reservation).
capabilities.failureMode: Colima unavailable -> adapter error -> node HOLD (fail-closed).
capabilities.evidenceRequirements: Mount allowlist verification (assertMountAllowlist), pinned socket resolution.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Host-side direct execution; read-only tasks where host trust suffices.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Writer mutations, independent review, anything touching secrets/credentials-adjacent paths, HIGH/CRITICAL tasks.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides isolation profile: none / host / worktree-only / Colima container.

capabilities.name: Dedicated git worktree isolation
capabilities.purpose: Clone-once + per-task `git worktree add --detach`; verify (root == worktree dir, clone main unpolluted), capture (changed files + diff), revoke (force remove, idempotent). Writes never reach the main checkout.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Writer sub-agent phases; mutationScope enforcement.
capabilities.permissions: Read-only source clone + per-task writable worktree.
capabilities.cost: Clone + worktree add + capture + revoke (seconds; git ops only).
capabilities.failureMode: verify fails -> HOLD; revoke idempotent on crash.
capabilities.isolationRequirements: Scratch root must be writable; source clone read-only.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Read-only tasks; XS trivial edits executed in-place (fast path).
capabilities.whenMandatory: Any isolated writer phase; any change to governed code under review.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides whether mutations are isolated (worktree) or in-place.

capabilities.name: Single-writer lease
capabilities.purpose: At most one writer mutation active at a time per repo/task; parallel mutation forbidden; lease restoration on resume is fail-closed (stale lease -> RESUME_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH; interrupted writer -> RECOVERY_REQUIRED, never blindly replayed).
capabilities.currentTrigger: Writer phase start (sealed runner) / resume.
capabilities.permissions: Holds exclusive mutation right.
capabilities.sideEffects: Lease state (in-memory in runner; persisted in durable layer).
capabilities.failureMode: Lease violation -> WRITER_LEASE_VIOLATION HOLD.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Read-only tasks; single-executor fast path.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Any graph with ≥1 writer node; parallel read-only workers must still serialize writers.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides concurrency profile: parallel read-only workers allowed, writers always serialized.

capabilities.name: Durable execution (journal + checkpoint + resume)
capabilities.purpose: DurableRun journals every safe boundary (PHASE_READY / EXECUTOR_COMPLETED / REVIEWER_COMPLETED / SYSTEM_DELTA_READY / PHASE_TERMINAL / RUN_TERMINAL) with deterministic execution/chain/checkpoint ids, hash-chain event log, CAS CURRENT.json; resume reconstructs the ready set from durable truth; never re-decomposes, never re-runs completed phases.
capabilities.currentTrigger: runDurableAutoLoop / runDurableGraph / resumeSubagentGraph; production sub-agent resume.
capabilities.currentCaller: autoloop.mjs entry, durable graph layer, sub-agent resume entry.
capabilities.permissions: Persistence authority over checkpoint store.
capabilities.cost: Measured (DE-2): disabled 643 ms / enabled 2335 ms / resume reconstruction 46 ms / D7 ~0 ms.
capabilities.failureMode: Corrupt/tampered checkpoint -> fail-closed reject at resume; pre-decomposition interruption -> RESTART_REQUIRED.
capabilities.isolationRequirements: Checkpoint store on durable local disk.
capabilities.evidenceRequirements: journal hash chain, checkpoint fingerprints, deterministic ids.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Ephemeral fast-path execution with no crash-resume requirement (XS/LOW, no state).
capabilities.whenMandatory: Long-running graphs, multi-stage (L/XL), HIGH/CRITICAL tasks, any task where a crash mid-writer is unacceptable.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides durability policy: ephemeral / durable / durable+resume.

capabilities.name: Checkpoint / resume
capabilities.purpose: Publish checkpoints at every safe boundary with checksum + CAS revision + structured lock + write permit; resume restores phase states, repair budget, permitted dirty digest; prevents admission drift by freezing configuration fingerprint (repair budget, IR sha, dag sha).
capabilities.currentTrigger: Every safe boundary in durable execution.
capabilities.permissions: Read/write checkpoint store only via C2D primitives.
capabilities.failureMode: Resume fingerprint mismatch -> HOLD (admission/config drift detected).
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Ephemeral execution.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Durable execution tasks; any task admitted as durable.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission result must be FROZEN into the checkpoint so a resume cannot drift to a different admission decision (anti-drift).

capabilities.name: Codebase Memory read-only retrieval
capabilities.purpose: Deterministic retrieval over the memory store: fixed ranking tuple, conflict-groups surfaced (never silently merged), store snapshot digest, deterministic retrievalDigest.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Explicit retrieval query by graph nodes/research.
capabilities.currentCaller: Graph nodes, research cards, sub-agents (when granted).
capabilities.permissions: Read-only queries.
capabilities.failureMode: Corrupt store -> fail-closed; conflicts surfaced not resolved.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Tasks with no memory dependency.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Tasks that need prior decision/architecture context; continuation tasks across sessions.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides whether memory retrieval is allowed and which scopes/queries.

capabilities.name: Codebase Memory governed write-back
capabilities.purpose: Persist memory records through the governed gate: candidate -> schema/identity -> authority/trust -> evidence -> scope -> security -> conflict analysis -> lifecycle intent -> journal append -> sqlite -> telemetry. Idempotent; conflicts surfaced; trust ladder (RAW/UNVERIFIED/VERIFIED/REVIEWED); stale code baselines marked STALE.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Explicit write-back candidates from graph completion (CBM-4); NOT automatic.
capabilities.permissions: Writes only through the gate; never partial; never silently overrides conflicts.
capabilities.failureMode: Any gate failure -> no partial write; WRITEBACK_* statuses.
capabilities.evidenceRequirements: Trust ladder bindings (verifier/review identities for VERIFIED/REVIEWED).
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Tasks whose results are transient or not memory-worthy.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Long-lived architecture/decision records; admission-relevant precedents (allowed to be recorded as memory AFTER admission, never to change a live admission).
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides whether write-back is authorized for the task and the evidence/trust level required.

capabilities.name: Telemetry / cost observability
capabilities.purpose: Allowlisted identity-bound telemetry events (never prompts/secrets/user data); deterministic eventIds; aggregates; budgets schema + SIMULATED enforcement only (enforced:false — not wired into production routing yet).
capabilities.currentTrigger: Graph run / node / repair events; observer.
capabilities.permissions: Writes bounded observation records.
capabilities.cost: Measured: ~1.71 ms enabled per graph vs 0.03 ms baseline (0.006% of a ~30 s graph).
capabilities.failureMode: TELEMETRY_UNAVAILABLE / TELEMETRY_STORE_INVALID — never a task authority.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Trivial fast-path tasks (may still record a minimal run event).
capabilities.whenMandatory: Any task where cost/quality observability is required; all durable/graph runs.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission can set telemetry detail level and (later) budget enforcement; admission quality metrics (overkill / under-classification) measured via telemetry.

capabilities.name: Review bundle generation + validation
capabilities.purpose: Generate the 25-section external review bundle from structured closeout source; recompute repo facts authoritatively; security scan (secrets, symlinks, binary/exec-bit, dependency changes); evidence manifest; delta-v1 inventory consistency (authorized/touched/CARD_IMPLEMENTATION_FILES) fail-closed.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Mandatory closeout at card completion (requiresReview).
capabilities.permissions: Writes bundle + evidence under authorized outDir only; no network; no remote writes.
capabilities.failureMode: Security check incomplete -> HOLD / SECURITY_CHECK_INCOMPLETE; inventory inconsistency -> REVIEW_BUNDLE_INVENTORY_INCONSISTENT.
capabilities.evidenceRequirements: Evidence manifest digest; bundle identity + sha256; patch/changed-tree identities.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Fast-path tasks with lightweight evidence (no external review).
capabilities.whenMandatory: Any task requiring external/controller review; governed milestones; one-card-one-review-surface targets.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides evidence level + bundle requirement: none / lightweight / full review bundle.

capabilities.name: External review delivery (fixed surface)
capabilities.purpose: Fixed inbox ~/Desktop/AutoLoop-Review/Current/ (review-bundle.txt + delivery.json + evidence.json), atomic publish under single-owner lock, occupancy fail-closed (unresolved occupant blocks), auto-rotate of resolved occupants; verdict is the sole receipt; AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW state.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Closeout with reviewBundleDeliveryRequired.
capabilities.permissions: Publish to the fixed surface under lock.
capabilities.sideEffects: Surface trio + archive rotation + delivery record.
capabilities.failureMode: surface_occupied / surface_busy -> AWAITING_BUNDLE_DELIVERY (never PASS).
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Internal-only tasks with no external review requirement.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Every externally reviewed card (the one-card-one-review-surface target).
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides external review requirement (none / controller-gate / external-review).

capabilities.name: Closeout state machine
capabilities.purpose: Persisted autoloop.closeout-state/v1 record; state-driven mandatory closeout; disposition (APPLIED/PASS) idempotent; AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW lifecycle.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Card completion when requiresReview.
capabilities.permissions: Writes closeout-state.json under authorized scope.
capabilities.failureMode: CLOSEOUT_METADATA_INCOMPLETE -> no bundle, no PASS.
capabilities.evidenceRequirements: bundle identity + sha recorded in state.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Fast-path tasks without review.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Governed cards.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides whether closeout/review lifecycle is engaged at all.

capabilities.name: Evidence generation (harness-owned)
capabilities.purpose: Harness-owned evidence: baseline capture, verification commands, system-observed delta, review evidence bundle, evidence manifest digests — never trusting executor self-reports.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Lifecycle verification; closeout; review evidence delivery.
capabilities.permissions: Collects system-observed facts; writes evidence artifacts under authorized dirs.
capabilities.failureMode: Evidence identity mismatch -> HOLD / EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Fast-path trivial tasks (minimal evidence).
capabilities.whenMandatory: Any reviewed/bound task.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission sets evidence level (none / ephemeral / persistent) per the IR EFFECT evidence_output values.

capabilities.name: Secret / security boundaries
module: src/adapter/pi-rpc-adapter.mjs (forbidden args, env allowlist, no-tools default)
capabilities.purpose: Secret scan on bundles; telemetry denylist (never secrets/user data); memory validation free-text scanning; pi adapter env allowlist + forbidden args (--approve/--session/--fork) + --no-tools default; symlink/binary/exec-bit checks fail-closed.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Bundle generation; telemetry ingestion; memory ingestion; every Pi spawn.
capabilities.currentCaller: Review bundle gate, telemetry gate, memory validation, pi adapter.
capabilities.permissions: Deny-by-default scanning.
capabilities.failureMode: Any uncertain check -> SECURITY_CHECK_INCOMPLETE HOLD.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: None — always on (defense in depth).
capabilities.whenMandatory: Always.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission flags secret/credential-adjacent tasks -> CRITICAL risk; capability grants must never include secret access.

capabilities.name: Lifecycle / authority governance
capabilities.purpose: Authorization schema v2 (top-level bindings, review_unit limits), effective authority (parent ∩ child ∩ runtime), lifecycle state machine, review-unit gate (max paths/lines/repairs), internal checkpoint commits vs integration-approved commits, push only after verified external PASS, draft-PR lifecycle.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Card authorization; checkpoints; closeout; external verdict ingestion; push/PR intent.
capabilities.permissions: Authority decision authority (scope, remote, branch, limits).
capabilities.sideEffects: Authority records, review history, gates HOLD.
capabilities.failureMode: HOLD / <specific_reason> taxonomy; AUTHORITY_ESCALATION_REJECTED.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Fast-path tasks with no commit/push intent.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Any card touching scope expansion, commits, push, PR, review.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission must be consistent with lifecycle authority: admission result is a derived decision that must not contradict the authority record (lifecycle/governance code changes are high-risk signals).

capabilities.name: Canonical risk normalization
capabilities.purpose: Single canonical risk authority: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL (MED alias only); unknown values rejected (fail-closed, never default); isStrictReviewRisk(HIGH|CRITICAL) drives strict-reviewer routing.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Every ingress point (card-input validation, producer, run-card).
capabilities.permissions: Normalizes/validates risk values.
capabilities.failureMode: RiskNormalizationError -> HOLD.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: None.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Always.
capabilities.admissionBearing: RISK axis of the admission decision reuses this canonical enum; admission ADDS the size axis and the capability/lifecycle projection on top.

capabilities.name: Task decomposition (IR v2)
capabilities.purpose: Decompose a parent task into IR v2 phases (purpose: analysis/implementation/verification/review/operation; effects: artifact_mutation / runtime_side_effect / external_system_mutation / evidence_output; boundaries; execution_policy executor/reviewer/multi_model_orchestration=false; dispositions).
capabilities.currentTrigger: Card execution start (before graph).
capabilities.permissions: Produces decomposition IR (structure only, no mutation).
capabilities.sideEffects: IR + decomposition evidence; checkpoint freezes IR sha.
capabilities.failureMode: DECOMPOSITION_NOT_BENEFICIAL / DECOMPOSITION_BLOCKED / HOLD on invalid IR.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Fast-path XS tasks (no decomposition).
capabilities.whenMandatory: M/L/XL tasks; tasks with multiple subsystems; high-risk tasks needing phase separation.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission decides BEFORE decomposition: whether decomposition is required, its depth bound, whether research/discovery must precede it, and the lifecycle weight it may consume.

capabilities.name: Pi × DeepSeek structured transport
capabilities.purpose: Pinned transport: provider=deepseek, model=deepseek-v4-flash, reasoningEffort=high, maxTokens=4096, timeout=120s, retries=0, no tools, response_format json_object; fail-closed payload guard (provider/model/tools/thinking/effort/maxToken); guarded fetch (host check, redirect manual, cross-host reject); empty content / stopReason=length / provider error -> HOLD; NO fallback model.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Every Pi Agent execution (executor, reviewer agents, decomposition).
capabilities.permissions: Model invocation only (no tools by default; tool policy explicit).
capabilities.cost: Per-call token cost; no retry budget.
capabilities.failureMode: Transport error -> HOLD (no silent retry).
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Deterministic (non-model) verifier nodes.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Any model-based executor/reviewer/decomposer node.
capabilities.admissionBearing: ADMISSION MUST NEVER ROUTE MODELS: Pi Agent execution is fixed to deepseek-v4-flash (R9). Admission only decides capability/envelope, never model choice.

capabilities.name: C2D atomic state machine
capabilities.purpose: Atomic state transitions for execution/commit candidates: acquireLease -> publishIntent -> discovery -> publishComplete -> publishCurrent -> releaseLease; deterministic execution/chain/checkpoint ids; exclusive-create index; reconcile; snapshot validation; commit materialization authorization.
capabilities.currentTrigger: Checkpoint publishes; commit candidates; operator-tick C2D path.
capabilities.permissions: Exclusive state transitions.
capabilities.failureMode: active_lease_conflict / HOLD; reconcile on crash.
capabilities.whenUnnecessary: Fast-path ephemeral tasks.
capabilities.whenMandatory: Durable tasks; commit-capable tasks.
capabilities.admissionBearing: Admission result can be persisted as a C2D-style record so it is atomically published and resume-safe.

crossCuttingFindings: The sub-agent envelope ALREADY carries toolPermissions + mutationScope per role — the enforcement surface for capability policy exists; TA-2 must make admission the AUTHORITY that fills those fields instead of the caller guessing.
risk-normalization.mjs is already the single canonical risk authority (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL) — admission's risk axis must reuse it, never invent a second enum.

IR v2 execution_policy already encodes executor/reviewer/multi_model_orchestration=false per decomposition — admission precedes decomposition, so it must constrain what the IR may request (never model routing).
There is NO size/complexity classification anywhere today — this is the genuinely new axis.

Telemetry budgets exist but are SIMULATED only (enforced:false) — admission must not pretend budget enforcement exists; TA-2 may wire admission-level budget selection, with enforcement deferred to the Cost Optimization stage.

One-card-one-review-surface is partially realized by the review-surface delivery (single Current/ inbox, supersede chain, FM-3) — TA-1 turns it into an admission-level contract so fast-path tasks are not forced through it and heavy chains cannot produce multiple manual review surfaces.
